# FastHTML

> Python と HTMX を組み合わせ、Starlette ベースの薄いフレームワークを通じて、開発者がサーバーサイド Python だけでリアクティブな Web アプリを迅速に構築できるよう提供する Web フレームワーク。

## Guide

- [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): In the interest of fostering an open and welcoming environment, we as contributors and maintainers pledge to make participation in our project and our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.
- [Core](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/api/00_core.ipynb): The FastHTML subclass of Starlette.
- [Components](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/api/01_components.ipynb): ft_html and ft_hx functions to add some conveniences to ft, along with a full set of basic HTML components, and functions to work with forms and FT conversion
- [Component extensions](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/api/02_xtend.ipynb): Simple extensions to standard HTML components, such as adding sensible defaults
- [Javascript examples](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/api/03_js.ipynb): Basic external Javascript lib wrappers
- [Pico.css components](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/api/04_pico.ipynb): Basic components for generating Pico CSS tags
- [SVG](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/api/05_svg.ipynb): Simple SVG FT elements
- [Jupyter compatibility](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/api/06_jupyter.ipynb): Use FastHTML in Jupyter notebooks
- [OAuth](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/api/08_oauth.ipynb): Basic scaffolding for handling OAuth
- [09 Cli](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/api/09_cli.ipynb)
- [Background Tasks](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/explains/background_tasks.ipynb): Background tasks are functions run after handlers return a response.
- [**FT** Components](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/explains/explaining_xt_components.ipynb): FT components turn Python objects into HTML.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/explains/faq.ipynb): Frequently Asked Questions
- [MiniDataAPI Spec](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/explains/minidataapi.ipynb): The MiniDataAPI is a persistence API specification that designed to be small and relatively easy to implement across a wide range of datastores.
- [OAuth](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/explains/oauth.ipynb): OAuth is an open standard for 'access delegation', commonly used as a way for Internet users to grant websites or applications access to their information on other websites but without giving them the passwords.
- [Routes](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/explains/routes.ipynb): Behaviour in FastHTML apps is defined by routes.
- [Stripe](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/explains/Stripe.ipynb): This guide will walk through a minimal example of working with a Stripe one-time payment link and webhook for secure reconciliation of payments.
- [WebSockets](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/explains/websockets.ipynb): Websockets are a protocol for two-way, persistent communication between a client and server.
- [FastHTML](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/index.ipynb): The fastest, most powerful way to create an HTML app
- [Concise reference](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/ref/concise_guide.ipynb): An information-dense guide showing LLMs how to create FastHTML apps with MonsterUI and Fastlite
- [Defining Xt Component](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/ref/defining_xt_component.ipynb)
- [Handling handlers](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/ref/handlers.ipynb): How handlers work in FastHTML
- [Live Reloading](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/ref/live_reload.ipynb): When building your app it can be useful to view your changes in a web browser as you make them.
- [Response Types](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/ref/response_types.ipynb): A list of the different HTTP response types available to your FastHTML route handlers.
- [FastHTML By Example](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/by_example.ipynb): An introduction to FastHTML from the ground up, with four complete examples
- [JS App Walkthrough](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/e2e.ipynb): How to build a website with custom JavaScript in FastHTML step-by-step
- [Using Jupyter to write FastHTML](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/jupyter_and_fasthtml.ipynb): Writing FastHTML applications in Jupyter notebooks requires a slightly different process than normal Python applications.
- [Web Devs Quickstart](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/tutorials/quickstart_for_web_devs.ipynb): A fast introduction to FastHTML for experienced web developers.
- [BYO Blog](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/fasthtml/blob/main/nbs/unpublished/tutorial_for_web_devs.ipynb): Learn the foundations of FastHTML by creating your own blogging system from scratch.
